profile_text.body:
Teradata describes itself as an AI platform for what it calls the autonomous era, built to connect and scale across any environment. Its central offering, the Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform, is presented as a way to make AI real, trusted, governed, and scalable for business use. The company says it offers a portfolio of products and services for AI, analytics, and cloud work, and that it partners with other providers to supply technology and AI-driven resources to customers.

The company is a public company traded under the ticker TDC, headquartered in San Diego, California, with SEC CIK number 0000816761. Its litigation record shows 281 cases in California.

No specific products or MCP servers are listed for the company in the material reviewed.
